# Selection by the record alone / 只读记录的选择

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-by-the-record-alone` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](selection-by-the-record-alone.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For options with decided equality and a record of entries of any kind: two options are selected alike by every selection reading the record alone exactly when the record ties them, and such a selection selecting at most one option can select k exactly when no other option's entry equals k's.
>
> 对相同已定的选项与任何种类条目的记录：两个选项被每个只读记录的选择选得相同，恰当记录使二者并列；至多选一个选项的这种选择能选出 k，恰当没有别的选项的条目等于 k 的。

## Laws / 规律

1. Exchanging two options (swap) is an involution. A selection, a valuation and a choice read the record alone when exchanging two options' entries exchanges what is selected, the values or the choice. Exchanging two tied options leaves the record as it was.<br>交换两个选项（swap）是对合。选择、取值与选取只读记录：交换两个选项的条目，即交换所选者、所取的值或所选取者。交换两个并列的选项，记录不变。 (`Becoming.Relabel.swap`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_left`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_right`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_other`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_swap`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_inj`, `Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice`, `Becoming.Relabel.fixed_of_tied`)
2. Tied options are selected alike, and two options are selected alike by every selection reading the record alone exactly when the record ties them. The witness selects the options whose entry equals a given value.<br>并列的选项被选得相同；两个选项被每个只读记录的选择选得相同，恰当记录使二者并列。见证是选出条目等于给定值的选项。 (`Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.tied`, `Becoming.Relabel.selected_alike_iff`)
3. A selection reading the record alone that selects at most one option selects no tied option, and none at a full tie of two or more. Holding an entry alone (Alone) is such a selection, so an option can be singled out exactly when no other option's entry ties it.<br>至多选一个的只读记录的选择不选并列的选项，两个以上选项全并列时不选。单独持有一个条目（Alone）是这样的选择，所以一个选项能被单独选出，恰当没有别的选项的条目与它相同。 (`Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.none_of_full_tie`, `Becoming.Relabel.Alone`, `Becoming.Relabel.alone_equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.alone_single`, `Becoming.Relabel.singled_iff_untied`)
4. A valuation reading the record alone, such as a weight on each option, gives tied options equal values, and every option the same at a full tie; the options taking a value form a selection reading the record alone; a constant valuation reads it; two options are valued alike by every such valuation exactly when tied.<br>只读记录的取值（如权重）给并列的选项相同的值，全并列时处处相同；取某值的选项是只读记录的选择；常值只读记录；两个选项被每个这样的取值取得相同，恰当二者并列。 (`Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.tied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.full_tie`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.level`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.const`, `Becoming.Relabel.entry_equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.valued_alike_iff`)
5. A choice of at most one option reading the record alone selects, reading the record alone, the option it chooses; it chooses no tied option and withholds at a full tie.<br>只读记录、至多选取一个选项的选取，其所选取者是只读记录的选择；它不选取并列的选项，全并列时不选取。 (`Becoming.Relabel.map_swap_eq_some`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.selects`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.single`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.withholds_of_full_tie`)
6. Instance (periphery, own checker, which also compiles and audits the originals): PluralRecords' records are records over Fin n, a rule treating the centers alike is a choice reading the record alone, and a lottery treating them alike in TieBreaking has weights reading it; seven theorems follow from the core, PluralRecords.pick finding the holder, every axiom report empty.<br>实例（外围，自有检查器，亦编译审计原文件）：PluralRecords 的记录即 Fin n 上的条目记录，同等对待中心的规则即只读记录的选取，TieBreaking 同等对待的抽签其权重只读记录；七条定理由核心律给出，PluralRecords.pick 找出单独持有者，公理报告皆空。 (`Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.transpose_eq_swap`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.treatsAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.lotteryAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.alone_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.tied_not_served_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.first_lt`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.all_tied_forces_withholding_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.servable_iff_untied_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.tied_equal_weight_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.full_tie_equal_weights_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.uniform_alike_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.pointMass_one`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.point_mass_not_alike_at_tie_by_core`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. The options' equality is decided (exchanging two options needs it); entries are of any kind; that a selection, valuation or choice reads the record alone is a hypothesis.<br>不加公理。选项的相同已定（交换两个选项需要它）；条目任意种类；选择、取值或选取只读记录是假设。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That an option singled out is found by a choice function: that needs a search over listed options, the periphery's PluralRecords.pick.<br>单独选出的选项由一个选取函数找到：这需在列出的选项中搜索，外围用 PluralRecords.pick。
- Whether an equal chance legitimately breaks a tie, or priority by size or by turn: these keep the originals' scope.<br>平局中等概率的抽签是否正当，按条目大小或按轮次的优先：保持原文件的范围。
- A form without the options' equality decided: exchanging two options needs it.<br>选项的相同不判定时的形式：交换两个选项需要判定。
